description: AICTIONBOT™ action check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit templates T07 (cross-functional action log) and T06 (implementation tracker). Takes the user's list of actions or tasks and returns a ready status report: done rate, overdue items sorted by days, blocked items, open items on the critical path, items due soon, items without an owner or due date, probable duplicates, people with more open items than the limit, and a red, yellow or green light per work package with progress. Per item: action, owner, due date, status (open, in progress, done, blocked), work package or workstream, progress in percent, critical path (yes/no). German or English column names are recognised (Maßnahme, Aufgabe, Verantwortlich, Termin, Status, Arbeitspaket, Fortschritt, kritischer Pfad). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

items.description: Action rows: action, owner, due (date), status, workstream, progress (percent), critical (yes/no).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

max_open_per_person.description: Open items per person above which overload is flagged. Default 8.

soon_days.description: Days ahead that count as due soon. Default 7.

name: check_actions
title: Check an action log or implementation tracker: overdue, blocked, no owner, no due date, duplicates, overload, traffic light per work package
